description: This file implements the BlobCache class, which manages in-memory and application-level caching of binary blobs for EGL_ANDROID_blob_cache support in the ANGLE project. It includes methods for storing, retrieving, and managing cached data, as well as setting callback functions for external cache integration.

classes.name: BlobCache
classes.description: A class that manages caching of binary blobs in memory and via external callbacks for EGL_ANDROID_blob_cache support.

methods.name: BlobCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size and null callback functions.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a blob in the cache, using external callback if set, otherwise internal cache.

methods.name: putApplication
methods.description: Stores a blob directly in the application cache if callback is set.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Adds a new cache entry with specified source.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a blob from cache, checking external callbacks first, then internal cache.

methods.name: getAt
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry at a specific index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: setBlobCacheFuncs
methods.description: Sets external callback functions for cache operations.

methods.name: areBlobCacheFuncsSet
methods.description: Checks if external cache callback functions are set.
